entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is taking forever and your service is already a joke.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Don't give me the runaround with your scripts! It's the wrong color. My wife ordered it for me and it's this hideous neon green. I wouldn't be caught dead in it. The box is unopened, still in the plastic wrap. I just want my money back.
I understand. I just need to pull up your order information. Can you confirm the order number or the email address associated with the purchase?

Ugh, fine. It's under angrycustomer@email.com. Just process the return. It's been less than a month. If you give me any trouble, I'm blasting you on social media. I'll make sure everyone knows VeloFit doesn't care about customer safety or satisfaction.
Thank you. I see the order here for the Urban Commuter Helmet. I'm just reviewing our return policy for you, sir. One moment.
Reviewing? It should be simple! You send me a label, I send back this awful helmet, you give me my money. If this takes more than another minute I want to speak to your manager right now.
There's no need for a manager, sir. I've just confirmed the policy. You are absolutely correct. Since you received the item just 26 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh. So you're taking it back then? No fee or anything?

That's right. Because the box is unopened and it's a simple color preference, there are no fees. I am generating a prepaid return shipping label and sending it to the email on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Okay. Good. That's what you should have done in the first place.

I apologize for any frustration, sir. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. Your safety is our priority, and that includes being comfortable with what you wear. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
I've just sent it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
